summary: Add the separate fleet gateway service, which holds the restricted SSH key and carries the browser web terminal, and direct Oathweave authentication for a static browser console. Resource enrollment now sends console drain challenges to the gateway at FLEET_GATEWAY_URL and fails closed without it, unless RESOURCE_ENROLLMENT_DASHBOARD_PARTICIPANT=absent. Assistant conversations, role and cron environment values and secret fingerprints are narrowed by ownership and role, and database error text no longer reaches clients. Base-data initialization and its completion receipt are committed atomically, verified before activation after an interrupted fresh install.

newOptionalEnv.name: FLEET_GATEWAY_URL
newOptionalEnv.description: HTTPS origin of the fleet gateway. Enables the console terminal capability and receives resource enrollment console drain challenges.

newOptionalEnv.name: FLEET_GATEWAY_TOKEN_SHA256
newOptionalEnv.description: SHA-256 digest of the credential the fleet gateway presents; required when FLEET_GATEWAY_URL is set.

newOptionalEnv.name: RESOURCE_ENROLLMENT_DASHBOARD_PARTICIPANT
newOptionalEnv.description: gateway (default) sends console drain challenges to FLEET_GATEWAY_URL; absent declares no console participant and is honoured only for a node with no console work rows.

newOptionalEnv.name: OATHWEAVE_ISSUER
newOptionalEnv.description: Exact issuer of Oathweave resource tokens (audience magnus). Cannot be combined with IAM_CORE_URL.

newOptionalEnv.name: OATHWEAVE_JWKS_URL
newOptionalEnv.description: HTTPS JWKS URL that verifies Oathweave token signatures; required when OATHWEAVE_ISSUER is set.

newOptionalEnv.name: OATHWEAVE_USERINFO_URL
newOptionalEnv.description: HTTPS userinfo URL for online session revocation; required when OATHWEAVE_ISSUER is set.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_OATHWEAVE_IDENTITIES_JSON
newOptionalEnv.description: Exact issuer and subject links to local users and role ceilings; required when OATHWEAVE_ISSUER is set.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_CONSOLE_BASE_PATH
newOptionalEnv.description: Path the console is served under, prefixed to links in notifications. Unset means the origin root.

newOptionalEnv.name: HIVE_REHEARSAL
newOptionalEnv.description: Isolated restore mode with no workers, timers, queue activation, mutations or host execution. Explicit true or false.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_HIVESKILLS_DEPLOYMENTS_JSON
newOptionalEnv.description: Optional endpoint-scoped HiveSkills executor grants by registry ID and exact target mapping.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_AGENT_HIVESKILLS_TARGETS_JSON
newOptionalEnv.description: Optional exact target mapping for native HiveSkills jobs; protected credentials stay on the host.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_AGENT_SELF_URL
newOptionalEnv.description: Verified HTTPS origin of this running agent for the acceptance command.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_AGENT_SELF_CA_PATH
newOptionalEnv.description: Optional private CA bundle for the agent acceptance endpoint.
